description: The VacationResponse/set handler catches NotFound from update_object and creates the singleton before re-applying the patch. The code comment explicitly notes the TOCTOU race and documents that backends must make create_object idempotent for the singleton key. This is the correct design for a handler layer that holds no shared state — the alternative (pre-checking existence) would not eliminate the race. A future contributor should not remove the comment or simplify to a pre-check without understanding the concurrency implications.
title: VacationResponse upsert: create-then-patch singleton with concurrency note
